programme.title: The Hills: Who Do You Trust?
programme.desc: Audrina berättar för Heidi om Spencers vänsterprassel, men Heidi tror inte på henne - förrän hon ser det med egna ögon. Lauren är fortfarande inte säker på om hon är redo för ett nytt förhållande.

programme.title: The Hills: One Big Interruption
programme.desc: Heidi tar en paus från Spencer men saknar honom mer än hon hade trott. Lauren ska planera en Teen Vogue-middag, men superpraktikanten Emily från New York tar över.

programme.title: The Hills: You Have Chosen
programme.desc: När Lauren berättar för Heidi vad hon egentligen tycker om Spencer måste Heidi välja mellan sin bästa vän och sin pojkvän.

programme.title: The Hills: With Friends Like These...
programme.desc: Lauren inser att hon inte kan lita på sin bästa vän när Heidi sammanför Jen och Brody.

programme.title: The Hills: Enough Is Enough
programme.desc: Spencer ber Heidi att flytta in hos honom, men Heidi vet inte vad hon ska göra eller hur hon ska berätta det för sin rumskompis Lauren.

programme.title: The Hills: New Year, New Friends
programme.desc: Laurens 21-årsdag är full av överraskningar när Heidi och Audrina håller en överraskningsfest för henne. Jen försöker sluta fred med Lauren.

programme.title: The Hills: Apology Not Accepted
programme.desc: Lauren fyller 21 och Heidi har stora planer för födelsedagskalaset. Men innan festen bestämmer hon sig för att berätta för Lauren att Spencer vill att de ska flytta ihop.

programme.title: The Hills: Goodbye for Now
programme.desc: I säsongsfinalen blir det spänt när Heidi måste besluta om hon ska flytta ihop med Spencer eller inte. Lauren vänder sig till Audrina när hon vill fylla tomrummet efter sin bästa vän, och Whitney flyger till New York för en intervju.

programme.title: The Hills: You Know What You Did
programme.desc: Lauren går inte på Heidis and Spencers inflyttningsfest, efter att ha hört att Heidi spridit rykten om henne. När Lauren och Heidi springer på varandra har de sitt hittills största gräl.

programme.title: The Hills: Big Girls Don't Cry
programme.desc: Lauren och Heidi kommer ännu längre från varandra när Spencer friar till Heidi. Audrina menar allvar med en pojkvän från förr och Lauren återvänder till Laguna Beach för att fråga om råd.

programme.title: The Hills: Truth And Time Tells All
programme.desc: Lauren försöker hjälpa Audrina att avgöra om Justin har det som krävs av en pojkvän, men Audrina har redan bestämt sig. Heidi märker att det inte alls är kul att vara förlovad och börjar flörta.

programme.title: The Hills: Meet The Parents
programme.desc: Med betoning på komiken får du se din favoritgrupp i reality-genren. Från Lauren till Spencer och alla mellan dem. Inget bitchigt ansiktsuttryck eller försök till fördjupad vänskap undgår våra blickar.

programme.title: The Hills: Rolling With The Enemy
programme.desc: Heidis sociala nätverk krymper när Spencer 'gör slut' med Brody för att istället hänga med Lauren. Audrina vill göra relationen med Justin officiell, men han vägrar.

programme.title: The Hills: Second Chances
programme.desc: Lauren känner en fläkt från det förflutna när expojkvännen Jason ringer. Heidi konkurrerar med jobbarkompisen Elodie om en högre tjänst.

programme.title: The Hills: They Meet Again
programme.desc: Laurens känslor för Jason har återvänt, men när de springer på Heidi och Spencer på en restaurang väcks upprörda känslor. Heidis befordran kostar henne Elodies vänskap.

programme.title: The Hills: For Better Or Worse
programme.desc: Lauren blir chockad när hon förstår att Jason har en flickvän, men Jason har en ännu större överraskning i beredskap. Heidi upptäcker att Spencer inte berättat för sina föräldrar om deras bröllopsplaner.

programme.title: The Hills: What Happens In Vegas...
programme.desc: Gänget firar Brodys födelsedag i Las Vegas. Audrinas pojkvän Justin skapar en klyfta i vänskapen mellan henne och Lauren. Attraktionen mellan Lauren och Brody växer.

programme.title: The Hills: What Goes Around
programme.desc: Jen Bunney säger till Lauren att Brody startade ryktesspridningen om henne, men Brody skyller på Spencer och lämnar Heidi i kläm mellan dem. Lauren ber Audrina om ursäkt för att hon blandat sig i relationen med Justin.

programme.title: The Hills: No More Mr. Nice Guy
programme.desc: Lauren börjar en ny romans med en manlig modell, men upptäcker att hon fortfarande har känslor för Brody. Spencer är rädd att han håller på att förlora Heidi till hennes nya jobb.

programme.title: The Hills: Stress And The City
programme.desc: Whitney och Lauren åker till New York för Teen Vogue och Spencer når fram till Brody.

programme.title: The Hills
programme.desc: Whitney och Lauren jobbar på Young Hollywood Party och Heidi firar sin 21:a födelsedag.

programme.title: The Hills: Forgive and Forget
programme.desc: Heidi och Lauren har ett nytt offentligt gräl, som får Heidi att komma tillbaka och be Lauren om ursäkt för allt som hänt. Audrinas relation med Justin går på i gamla hjulspår, men karriären på Epic Records tar fart.

programme.title: The Hills: With This Ring...
programme.desc: Lauren leker äktenskapsmäklare när Whitney går på sin första dejt med deras personlige tränare. Spencer motarbetar Heidis planer för ett sagobröllop, med ett gräl som hotar förlovningen som resultat.

programme.title: The Hills: A Night At The Opera
programme.desc: Audrina får syn på Justin när han kysser en annan tjej, vilket leder till en slutlig konfrontation om deras relation. Heidi blir chockad när Spencers syster Stephanie muckar gräl med Lauren och Brody på en nattklubb.

programme.title: The Hills: Once a Player
programme.desc: Lauren tror att Brody kanske är för mycket av en playboy, för att hon ska kunna mena allvar med honom. Spencers syster berättar för honom att Heidi i hemlighet hyser tvivel inför deras bröllop.

programme.title: The Hills: When One Door Closes...

programme.desc: I säsongstarten kastar vi oss rakt in i den årliga frulunchen med Elena Belle som värdinna. Det blir en händelserik frulunch som sätter tonen för hela säsongen när gamla konflikter blossar upp.

programme.title: Svenska Hollywoodfruar: Avsnitt 1302
programme.desc: Siv Cotton tar med oss till jobbet. Elena Belle vill komma närmre Gunilla Persson och bjuder hem henne som smakråd. Marias recept för ett lyckligt äktenskap är detsamma som tidigare.

programme.title: Svenska Hollywoodfruar: Avsnitt 1303
programme.desc: Sveriges största humorgrupp JLC är på genomresa i Kalifornien och passar på att hälsa på hemma hos Maria Montazami. Gunilla Persson tänker tillbaka på den ödesdigra natten då hennes hus brann ner.

programme.title: Svenska Hollywoodfruar: Avsnitt 1304
programme.desc: Elena Belle ställer till kalas med USA-tema för att fira att hon och kompisen Louise äntligen fått sina efterlängtade Green Cards. Siv Cottons dotter Charlize gör en stor bikiniplåtning för Elle.

programme.title: Svenska Hollywoodfruar: Avsnitt 1305
programme.desc: Det har blivit dags för de Svenska Hollywoodfruarnas årliga övernattning och den här gången står Maria Montazami för värdinneskapet.

programme.title: Svenska Hollywoodfruar: Avsnitt 1306
programme.desc: Det är dags för frukost och avrundning av fruarnas övernattning på ranchen, men trots att kvällen innan slutat i skratt så är alla inte riktigt nöjda med upplevelsen de haft tillsammans.

programme.title: Svenska Hollywoodfruar: Avsnitt 1307
programme.desc: För första gången i Svenska Hollywoodfruars historia träffas Gunilla Persson och Maria Montazami på tu man hand över en båttur där Gunilla får träffa Marias man Kamran och dottern Hanna.

programme.title: Svenska Hollywoodfruar: Avsnitt 1308
programme.desc: På en exotisk location ute i öknen är det dags för Elena Belle att göra comeback som bikinimodell. Gunilla Persson förbereder sig inför sitt kommande Garden Party och hyr in en handy man.

programme.title: Svenska Hollywoodfruar: Avsnitt 1309
programme.desc: Gunilla Persson bjuder med Åsa Vesterlund på samtalsterapi. Gunillas Garden Party blir en ”Grande Finale” på alla sätt och vis med allt från tårtfest till gråtfest. Kommer alla fruar försonas?

programme.title: Svenska Hollywoodfruar: Avsnitt 1001
programme.desc: Sofie Prydz är fru till en DJ. Elena Belle är fästmö till en manager för DJ:s. I premiären stålsätter de sig för att möta de tre veteranerna – Maria Montazami, Gunilla Persson och Åsa Vesterlund.

programme.title: Svenska Hollywoodfruar: Avsnitt 1002

programme.title: Svenska Hollywoodfruar: Avsnitt 1003
programme.desc: Man kan skära genom den spända spänningen i luften och känslorna sitter på utsidan. Det är dags för den årliga frulunchen och Sofie Prydz vet knappt vad som väntar.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Blackout
programme.desc: Walker, under täckmantel för att slå ut en kasinoägares penningtvättsystem, blir medvetslös efter ett slag mot huvudet, och han vaknar med minnesförlust medan han släpas ut ur kasinot av en ung, kvinnlig blackjack-croupier.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Deadline
programme.desc: När en rik delstatssenator försöker upplösa Texas Rangers med budgetnedskärningar som skäl närvarar Trivette vid en utfrågning för att tala till förmån för Rangers, men Walker vägrar försvara en institution som han säger inte behöver försvaras.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Belägring
programme.desc: Rangers semester i ett avlägset området förvandlas till en katt-och-råtta-lek med en ökänd heroinlangare som fångar Walker, Trivette, CD och Alex i en tom stuga efter att Alex råkar bevittna hans smutsiga affärer.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Moskva-kontakt
programme.desc: När en rad lagerrån leder Walker och Trivette till en rysk gangster kallar Rangers in Moskva-polisen för att hjälpa till att identifiera och fånga missdådaren.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Miraklet i Middle Creek
programme.desc: När en sexårig pojke faller ner i en 12 meter djup avloppsbrunn försöker Walker rädda honom, men när brunnen kollapsar blir Walker och pojken fast utan mycket hopp om räddning.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Hall of Fame
programme.desc: Kvällen innan CD ska upptas i Texas Rangers Hall of Fame återvänder en seriemördare från ett 11 år gammalt olöst fall för att hemsöka honom, och han ifrågasätter om han är värdig äran.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Högre makt
programme.desc: En tibetansk munk upptäcker att den kände buddhistläraren lama Dolgins ande har reinkarnerats som en ung pojke och försöker ta pojken tillbaka till Tibet.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Patriot
programme.desc: När Walker och Trivette griper ledaren för en vit makt-grupp hämnas gruppen genom att ta Alex och de anställda på en minoritetsägd TV-station som gisslan.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Spökryttare
programme.desc: När byggarbetare gräver fram en ung indianpojkes förmultnade kropp ger sig Walker och Trivette ut för att lösa ett åtta år gammalt brott.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Brödraskap
programme.desc: När ett hämndlystet polisbrödraskap börjar mörda skurkar som släpps fria på grund av teknikaliteter måste Walker sätta stopp för skräckväldet.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Pest

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Estonia (Part 2)
programme.desc: Estonia has embarked on a journey greatly inspired by the nordic cuisine. Tareq explores the countryside of Estonia before he returns to the capital of Tallinn where he meets people that really love their traditional food.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Öland
programme.desc: Tareq bikes through the unique landscape of Öland, Sweden's second largest island located in the Baltic Sea. It is a place where the interaction between man and nature have created a diverse and rich farmland with an amazing amount of small producers.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Bornholm
programme.desc: Bornholm, the sunny bright green island with it’s own gastronomic tone is a true pioneer when it comes to local food at it’s finest quality. Tareq visit Denmark's first regional food culture house where they develop this unique flourishing cuisine.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Laponia
programme.desc: In the northern part of Sweden, you’ll find the stunning world heritage Laponia. Almost 10.000 square kilometres of nature reserves and national parks. Tareq visit the rich, unique culture of the sami in the vast impressive wilderness.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Malmö & Copenhagen
programme.desc: Tareq Taylor returns to his home turf to see what has happened and what the future might bring to the new nordic cuisine. He visits a local goat farmer and meets up with young enthusiastic chefs who takes this nordic legacy further.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Zealand
programme.desc: Tareq Taylor visits the South Coast of Denmark to make his own versions of open-faced sandwiches and smoked fish dishes.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Dalsland
programme.desc: Tareq Taylor puts on his hiking boots and explores the pilgrim trail of Dalsland in West Sweden. This episode will include outdoor cooking, foraging and beaver safari.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Stockholm
programme.desc: When Tareq arrives in Stockholm he will meet innovation and world class gastronomy, a big city for foodies. He will make some pizza at the Rosendal garden café and go on an adventure in the archipielago.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Lolland
programme.desc: When Michelin star chefs move from Copenhagen to the countryside, they often end up in Lolland/Falster. Here Tareq will meet Claus Meyer the father of new nordic cuisine and other entrepreneurs that opened interesting restaurants here.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Skåne
programme.desc: Tareq Taylor explores his own backyard of Skåne and hometown of Malmö, a multi cultural food mix. Here you can find food and culture from all over the world that makes it a unique culinary destination.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Best Of
programme.desc: Tareq Taylor looks back on some of the food adventures he has been part of in the program series Nordic Cookery. Tareq promises delicacies from all over the Nordics and meetings with fantastic people along the way.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Läckö & Kinnekulle
programme.desc: By Lake Vänern you find Läckö and Kinnekulle, an area rich in history, culture and traditions. Tareq cooks exciting dishes on vendice roe, fish and local cheeses - all served on porcelain from the world-famous Rörstrand.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Sjuhärad
programme.desc: Sjuhärad is nature and culture in perfect symbiosis. Tareq takes the bike to meet some of the food entrepreneurs in the area who have started exciting new businesses. Here you live close to nature, forest and lakes.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Greater Copenhagen
programme.desc: Copenhagen and Skåne are a hot food destinations. Tareq visits Østergro, Denmark's first "rooftop farm" in the middle of Copenhagen, Eden in the new district Hyllie, Malmö and Häckeberga Castle where there will be wild boar for dinner.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Höganäs
programme.desc: The wild coast at Kullaberg in Skåne has a lot of culture and gastronomy to offer. Fantastic ceramics, vineyards and world-class ice cream. Tareq visits VikenTomater and cooks vegetarian ragù

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Karlstad
programme.desc: Tareq visits sunny Karlstad! Here, food is prepared by Vänern's shores and in Värmland's deep forests. Butter-fried Zander, crepes and cooking over an open fire are on the menu.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Best Of (Part 2)
programme.desc: Once again, Tareq Taylor looks back on some of the food adventures he has been part of in the program series Nordic Cookery. Tareq promises delicacies from all over the Nordics and meetings with fantastic people along the way.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Lund
programme.desc: In this episode, Tareq visits Lund, a thousand-year old city in southern Sweden. Lund is surrounded by the richest farmland in the country, and we explore nearby islands and meet entrepreneurs making highly-regarded local products.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Bornholm
programme.desc: Tareq sails out to Bornholm, a Danish island close to southern tip of Sweden. The islanders are fiercely self-sufficient and this attitude reflects in the huge number of food producers making products that are sold both locally and internationally.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Jokkmokk
programme.desc: Far above the Arctic Circle, Tareq explores the wild country around Jokkmokk. Here, the Sami people lived from what the land provides for thousands of years. This wild cuisine is as extreme as the weather here.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Åland
programme.desc: For hundreds of years, Åland’s shipping fleet was the envy of navies around the world, and their sea trade was encouraged by the seafood, grains and fruits that thrive on these islands. Tareq prepares recipes to reflect Åland’s unique cuisine.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Malmö
programme.desc: Tareq is in his hometown of Malmö – Sweden’s third largest city. The food scene here is inspired by the traditional seafood dishes and the large immigrant population whose recipes have given Malmö a new energy.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Finland's South Coast
programme.desc: Tareq takes a late autumn trip along Finland’s southern coast. He stops in the capital Helsinki to see how the city's food culture is about to be discovered by the rest of the world, and dives into the freezing waters around Ekenäs.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Kiruna
programme.desc: Tareq arrives in Kiruna, over 200km north of the Arctic Circle. With the weather getting down to -30C, Tareq takes part in snow picnics, firing up the smoker, and using snow and ice as part of the recipes he prepares.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Bergen
programme.desc: Surrounded by some of the most beautiful landscapes in northern Europe, Bergen has become a centre for the finest seafood in northern Europe. Tareq heads into this winter wonderland to see the curious cuisine that has developed in western Norway.

programme.desc: Tareq comes to understand what is in the soul of the Faroese, and why their cuisine has developed the way it has. We explore the beautiful capital Torshavn and surrounding villages, and sail into a cave for a recipe prepared on a rowboat.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Central Jutland
programme.desc: Volcanoes and glaciers shaped this part of the country, leaving a giant fjord and pre-historic fossils in their wake. Farmers and food innovators work closely with nature to prepare food with the area’s plentiful herbs and award-winning seafood.

programme.title: Earth: Final Conflict: Payback
programme.desc: A mysterious death by poisoning creates questions about the safety of portal technology. When a Taelon is killed in the same manner, the investigation leads to a very smart scientist that even the Resistance was scared to work with.

programme.title: Earth: Final Conflict: Friendly Fire
programme.desc: Paul Chandler plots an attack on the Taelon Embassy in DC with the ship he stole from Lili. He begs her to join him in beginning an all out war.

programme.title: Earth: Final Conflict: Volunteers
programme.desc: A group of Resistance capture a volunteer from a Taelon program for youth. Liam decides they may learn valuable information from her. They also decide to send in one of their own as a volunteer to see what the program is teaching.

programme.title: Earth: Final Conflict: Bliss
programme.desc: Lili is given a psychotropic drug called "bliss" via a Taelon device. They discover it is widespread. With an instantly strong addictive property, the addicts are dying within 48 hours. The investigation leads Liam and Sandoval to Ireland.

programme.title: Earth: Final Conflict: Highjacked
programme.desc: With a reporter on board, the Taelon mother ship is highjacked into interdimensional space. Liam is the prime suspect, causing an even bigger rift between Da'an and Zo'or. As the ship floats, lost in space, they must find the real culprit.

programme.title: Earth: Final Conflict: Defector
programme.desc: A shuttle crashes on a beach after being pursued by a second Taelon piloted shuttle. When Liam locates the survivor (a Taelon called Belleye), he claims to want to help the Resistance take back Earth from the Taelons.

programme.title: Earth: Final Conflict: Heroes and Heartbreak
programme.desc: Augur is recruited by a Taelon weapons project, but the others are worried about his involvement. When the project is launched earlier than originally planned to fight a Jiridian fleet, the Earth is in danger.

programme.title: Earth: Final Conflict: Message in a Bottle
programme.desc: A Jiridian probe headed for Earth is shot down by the Taelon Embassy and crashes outside of D.C. Liam recovers the probe, but he, Augur, and Julia are captured by another underground resistance movement led by the real Colonel Liam Kincaid.

programme.title: Earth: Final Conflict: Crossfire
programme.desc: As the election draws near, Liam believes Zo'or is trying to have Jonathan Doors murdered. The Resistance worries that an attack is imminent at the final debate. Julia mobilizes a group to protect Doors against Liam's wishes.

programme.title: Earth: Final Conflict: Crackdown
programme.desc: An unknown woman saves Augur and Liam from the raids on the Resistance. Lili sabotages the mother ship, but Zo'or stops its total destruction. Lili is reportedly dead. The investigation on the President's shooter continues.

programme.title: Earth: Final Conflict: The Vanished
programme.desc: Some who were detained during the Resistance sweep have not reappeared after their release. Lili is taken to a lab run by Sandoval and implanted. Renee tries to help Liam find the missing people.

programme.title: Earth: Final Conflict: Emancipation
programme.desc: A group posing as volunteers attacks using a stolen skrill prototype that does not require an implant to control. It is discovered that the skrill queen is also missing. The investigation leads to a resistance group called Black Wednesday.

programme.title: Earth: Final Conflict: Déjà Vu
programme.desc: A joint Doors International/Taelon venture creates a machine that allows people to vividly relive a memory, but Liam suspects a back alley version of the device is leading to the death of some users.

programme.title: Earth: Final Conflict: The Once and Future World
programme.desc: Artifacts believed to be Taelon are found in South America. Renee and Liam try to beat Sandoval to the source to determine the importance of the found pieces.

programme.title: Earth: Final Conflict: Thicker than Blood
programme.desc: An old business partner of Augur's is hired by Da'an to get information about the Resistance, resulting in the death of many members. Meanwhile, Sandoval finds out he has a life threatening blood disorder.

programme.title: Earth: Final Conflict: A Little Bit of Heaven
programme.desc: Liam and Renee investigate a dead pregnant woman missing her fetus. They discover a town that Da'an helped after a nuclear meltdown and a suspicious brother and sister who were part of an early experiment to combine human and Taelon DNA.

programme.title: Earth: Final Conflict: Pad'ar
programme.desc: Pad'ar is a fierce battle game where spectators can connect via a "jack patch" that Liam suspects is causing neurological damage to users. When a Pad'ar warrior dies, it raises even more questions about the safety.

programme.title: Earth: Final Conflict: In Memory
programme.desc: Lili wakes up, supposedly on Earth after a coma, and is told the Jaridians have come and conquered the Taelons. She remembers Sandoval telling her she no longer has and Earth-based physiology and believes things are not as they seem.

programme.title: Earth: Final Conflict: The Cloister
programme.desc: Zo'or and Da'an travel to a cloister for an energy sharing ceremony, but one of the sisters is killed and everyone is a suspect.

programme.title: Earth: Final Conflict: Interview
programme.desc: Zo'or agrees to do a live television interview to try to endear himself to humans, but the show's producer has an ulterior motive in getting him in front of a camera.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Shadow Play
programme.desc: Adam Grant is trapped in a recurring nightmare, in which he is sentenced to death and executed.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Mind and the Matter
programme.desc: Using the power of mind over matter, Archibald Beechcroft remakes the world to his own specifications.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Will the Real Martian Please Stand Up
programme.sub-title: Will the Real Martian Please Stand Up
programme.desc: Following a frantic phone call about a crashed spaceship, two policemen try and determine who among the passengers of a bus at a snowed-in roadside diner is from another world.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Obsolete Man
programme.desc: In a future totalitarian society, a librarian is declared obsolete and sentenced to death.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Two
programme.desc: A man and a woman, on opposite sides of a future war, encounter each other in a deserted town.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Dream Me a Life
programme.desc: A man in a retirement home dreams of a woman holding back a monster, and in real life realizes the woman is his cataleptic neighbor.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Memories
programme.desc: A hypnotist who specializes in helping people relive their past lives tries to find her own history. She hypnotizes herself and when she awakens, she learns that everyone can now remember their past lives. They also desperately want to forget them.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Hellgramite Method
programme.desc: An alcoholic goes through an extremely painful and potentially deadly cure for his drinking problem. He has to choose which is more important - the bottle or his life.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Our Selina is Dying
programme.desc: A young woman, Debra, comes to live with her mysterious family, including the dying patriarch Selena. After Selena clutches Debra's hand firmly leaving an odd spot on it, Debra begins to age very fast while Selena rejuvenates.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Arrival
programme.desc: A plane lands safely, but the pilot, crew and all of its passengers are missing!

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Shelter
programme.desc: When a nuclear attack appears imminent, several suburban friends and neighbors fight over control of a single bomb shelter.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Passersby
programme.desc: On the road home from the Civil War, a Confederate soldier stops at a burned-out house and gets to know the owner, a recent widow.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: A Game of Pool
programme.desc: Championship pool player Fats Brown returns from the grave for one last game.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Mirror
programme.desc: After a poor but ambitious Central American farm worker overthrows his country's tyrannical leader, he believes he sees assassins everywhere. A look in the mirror reveals his most dangerous enemy.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Grave
programme.desc: Before he died, notorious gunslinger Pinto Sykes put a curse on hired-gun Conny Miller. Miller returns to town and is challenged to visit the grave of Sykes, despite the curse.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Call
programme.desc: A lonely man accidentally phones the wrong number and finds an intriguing female to whom he grows attached. When she refuses to meet him, he investigates and finds the phone in a museum next to the statue of a woman.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Trance

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey: The Gimp
programme.desc: While investigating a series of muggings of disabled persons, Cagney (Sharon Gless) gets a first-hand look at the problems they face and becomes romantically involved with a man (guest star James Stacy) who is handicapped and advocating for change.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey: Family Connections
programme.desc: Cagney has to rush to Lacey's side at the hospital, hoping that she can make it before the baby is delivered. Being around Lacey and her family makes Cagney have second thoughts about her life as a singleton. Cagney's father has a new girlfriend.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey: Post Partum
programme.desc: Cagney (Sharon Gless) becomes involved in a case where a West Point cadet is charged with possession of cocaine and is refusing to help himself due to his honor code. Meanwhile, Lacey's (Tyne Daly) father pays her a visit after a 30-year absence.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey: Man Who Shot Trotsky
programme.desc: Cagney (Sharon Gless) and Lacey (Tyne Daly) receive a second opportunity to nail a notorious narcotics dealer as Petrie (Carl Lumbly) and Isbecki (Martin Kove) go 'off-Broadway' to pursue a murder case. Also starring Al Waxman as Lt. Bert Samuels.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey: Exit Stage Center (S04E19)
programme.desc: When a famous actress dies, the first assumption is suicide. However, as Cagney and Lacey investigate, they soon discover that she was murdered and everyone in the cast and crew of the play she was in has a probable motive for killing her.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey: Capitalism
programme.desc: Cagney (Sharon Gless) and Lacey (Tyne Daly) investigate the murder of a prominent and well-respected Cambodian immigrant lawyer and discover his business might not be as it appears. Also starring Al Waxman as Lt. Bert Samuels.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey: Extradition
programme.desc: Cagney (Sharon Gless) and Lacey (Tyne Daly) are sent to Los Angeles to extradite an old 'perp' as Cagney meets her brother Brian's (guest star David Ackroyd) family for the first time in 12 years. Also starring Al Waxman as Lt. Bert Samuels.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey: A Safe Place
programme.desc: When a vial of plutonium is stolen from a scientist, Cagney (Sharon Gless) and Lacey (Tyne Daly) run up against government barriers trying to locate the lethal radioactive material before the thief becomes terminally ill.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey: Model Citizen
programme.desc: Cagney (Sharon Gless) and Lacey (Tyne Daly) investigate the gangland-style murder of a highly respected union leader, making everyone question why a man with a spotless record would be murdered in the first place. Also starring Al Waxman.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey: Parting Shots
programme.desc: Detective Jonah Newman (guest star Dan Shor) is gunned down in front of his fellow detectives who must find the killer while coming to grips with the loss of their colleague and the danger of their jobs. Starring Sharon Gless and Tyne Daly.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey: You Call This Plainclothes?
programme.desc: After a series of murders take place involving prostitutes, Cagney (Meg Foster) and Lacey (Tyne Daly) go undercover in the hopes of finding who keeps killing the women. Also starring Al Waxman, Carl Lumbly, and John Karlen.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Soldier Stories
programme.desc: This show profiles the work of world-renowned forensic experts as they work to tell the stories of the young men who went to war (from the French and Indian war to Vietnam) and never came back.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Drawing Conclusions
programme.desc: A teenager is abducted on a shopping trip. Two hikers disappear from the Appalachian Trail.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Price of Murder
programme.desc: Using science as their most powerful weapon, investigators must find these hired killers and make them pay the true price of murder.

programme.title: The New Detectives: A Taste of Poison
programme.desc: Poisoners are the most devious of killers, relying on stealth or their victim's trust in order to steal their lives. They're the most dangerous creatures in the world: smart assassins. And they usually don't stop at one kill.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Proof Of Innocence
programme.desc: DNA analysis overturns the convictions of three men who have spent years behind bars, paying for crimes they did not commit.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Patterns Of Guilt
programme.desc: The tread of a tire, a single shoe print and even the shape of a bruise help investigators track down killers, based solely on their patterns of guilt.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Crimes Of Passion
programme.desc: When killers are driven by jealousy and desire, their desperation is evident in both the crime and their efforts to avoid detection. But forensic science can reveal even the slightest mistake to solve crimes of passion.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Coroner Investigator
programme.desc: CI: Coroner Investigator will reveal the most in-depth look to date into the science of death.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Trial By Fire
programme.desc: At a crime scene, anything left behind or seemingly out of place is considered a clue. But a fire can extinguish everything in its path challenging forensic investigators at every turn and making each arson a trial by fire.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Stolen Youths
programme.desc: A young girl playing in her yard in Spokane, Washington suddenly vanishes. In St. Louis, another girl leaves to visit a friend. She never arrived.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Partners In Crime
programme.desc: They say that a burden shared is a burden halved, but when partners team up to commit murder, the weight of their guilt remains just as heavy. Investigators must rely on forensic science to capture partners in crime.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Cold Cases
programme.desc: These cases took a decade or more to solve. There's no statute of limitations on murder. As a case turns cold, the clues become scarce, investigators must rely on science to close cold cases.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Blind Trust
programme.desc: A woman's body is found and investigators have little time and few clues to lead them to a killer who could strike again. Perpetrators try to conceal their crimes, yet savvy investigators can take the most obscure data and recreate a murder.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Shreds of Evidence
programme.desc: Hairs and Fibers: The tiniest filament can become a mark of distinction in the most singular and intimate of ways. Investigators have come to rely on forensic evidence as fine as a carpet fiber or as innocent as an eyelash to crack difficult cases.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Grave Discoveries
programme.desc: Some cases simply can't be solved with current technology or with the evidence at hand. But that doesn't mean they'll remain unsolved forever.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Infallible Witness
programme.desc: Investigators are always on the cutting edge of new forensic techniques that can help them solve cases more accurately. An experimental "brain fingerprinting" technique has already won the acquittal of a police officer accused of a drug charge.
